text: dsh-bot 是面向 DSH Web 的常驻 Bot 团队插件：它在侧边栏提供聊天工作台，并让每个 Bot 使用真实的 DSH Agent 会话。用户可以创建和管理 Bot 与群组，进行私聊和 @成员群聊，保存个人或团队记忆，安排定时任务，并把工作分派给后台任务或辅助会话。Bot 可配置角色、指令、模型和权限；工作台支持中英文界面、消息流、文件与图片输入。适合希望在 DSH 中组织多个专职 Agent、持续对话并自动分工的用户；需要 DSH Web 扩展及其会话、工具和调度服务。

dsh-bot adds a Bot team to DSH Web. Its sidebar supports private and group chats using real DSH Agent sessions. Users can manage Bots, share memory, schedule work, and delegate background tasks. It helps users coordinate agents and requires DSH Web host services.

需要让 Agent 定时运行任务并把结果发回会话
想把一批工作分派到后台处理，不要卡住当前聊天
能不能在网页侧边栏统一管理多个 Bot 的私聊和群聊？
I want a team of persistent AI agents with different roles in DSH.
How can I schedule work and delegate tasks to background agents?
dsh-bot 的多 Bot 私聊与群聊：在侧边栏工作台选择会话并发送消息，每条回复由对应 Bot 的真实 DSH Agent 会话生成；群聊支持 @成员、管理员或全员回复模式及交接上下文。
dsh-bot 的团队记忆：用户或 Bot 可保存、查看和删除个人或共享记忆，系统会在后续会话中选取相关内容作为上下文，供团队持续协作。
dsh-bot 的定时与后台任务：可为 Bot 创建计划任务，也可将任务批量派发到后台处理、查看状态或取消；结果可返回给发起会话。
dsh-bot 的 Bot 团队管理：主 Bot 可创建、修改和删除成员及群组，并设置成员角色、模型和权限；网页工作台提供对应的会话和设置界面。

@lisongjianustc/dsh-bot README · Why：In DSH a Session *is* an Agent. dsh-bot does not invent a second execution layer: it gives each Bot its own real Session (grouped in a dedicated workspace), injects the Bot persona/team/memory into the prompt, and turns every message into one real turn. The workbench is a thin product layer on top — so you keep native tool cards, approvals, queueing, search and model selection for free.

@lisongjianustc/dsh-bot README · Features：| Area | What you get |
|---|---|
| **Bot team** | Named Bots with role, instructions, avatar, model, reasoning effort, permission preset and pinned workspace. Chief Bot is created first and is the only one that may edit the roster and groups. |
| **Pinned chats** | Pin any conversation; Chief's private chat is pinned on first launch. |
| **Private chats** | Every message is one real Agent turn. Streaming text, tool rows, retry, cancel, quote, copy, markdown rendering. |
| **Group chats** | `@Name` mentions, admin/all reply modes, `[PASS]` skipping, hop limit with a wrap-up turn, handover of the previous conclusion, and a group note that survives clearing the chat. The main Bot can create/update/delete groups and post into any group. |
| **Task dispatch** | `bot_dispatch_tasks` / `bot_get_tasks` / `bot_cancel_tasks`: batched background delegation with request-id idempotency, receipts, result relay and cancel cascade. |
| **Background helpers** | Hidden child sessions for work that should not block the chat; the report comes back and the Bot verifies it in its own words. |
| **Memory** | One store per Bot plus one shared by the team, selecte

@lisongjianustc/dsh-bot README · Install：**From the plugin market** (once listed): install `@lisongjianustc/dsh-bot` from Settings → Plugins → Discover, or the Workshop card.

**From this repository** (local development):

```sh
git clone https://github.com/lisongjianustc/dsh-bot.git

@lisongjianustc/dsh-bot README · or: dsh plugin add @lisongjianustc/dsh-bot   (after npm publish)：node scripts/build-client.mjs
```

Then open the **Bot team** row in the sidebar, click **Create the default Bot**, and send your first message.

> Requirement: DSH `>= 0.2.2-rc.1` with the Web extension bundle.

@lisongjianustc/dsh-bot README · Quick start：1. Open the workbench → the empty state creates **Chief** (team lead, automatic pinned chat).
2. Ask Chief to build a team: *“Create a researcher and an engineer, then open a group with both.”*
3. Chat privately, or post a group discussion; mention members with `@Alice`.
4. Attach an image or a file — the Bot gets the path and can read it.
5. Pin any conversation; Chief's chat is pinned by default.

@lisongjianustc/dsh-bot README · Architecture：```
Browser (client half)                      Host process (host half)
┌──────────────────────────────┐           ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ sidebar row + workbench page │  HTTP/SSE │ /dsh-bot/api/*  (webServer routes)      │
│ composer · timeline · settings├──────────►│ ledger (state.json + per-chat JSONL)   │
